chunks: The runaway slave's salat (prayer) is not accepted until he returns to his master.

key_terms.الْآبِقُ: the one who has absconded or run away from his master
key_terms.اَلْعَبْدُ: the slave; the legally bound servant being discussed
key_terms.مَوْلَاهُ: his master; the one to whom he belongs in this context

ai.seo_question: Is the salat (prayer) of a runaway slave accepted before he returns to his master?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the salat (prayer) of an absconding slave is not accepted while he remains in a state of flight from his master. It connects the validity or acceptance of worship to the fulfillment of an existing duty and the restoration of the violated right.
